claim: Apply the original's 8-bit x wrap before clipping, and reject out-of-view x before an 8-bit x plus width test can wrap.

evidence.text: Apply eight-bit x wrap before clipping (255+1=0).
evidence.quote: Apply eight-bit x wrap before clipping (255+1=0);

evidence.text: The original renderer allows linear right-edge spill: clip against the 192-pixel original buffer before translating to the 256-pixel display; reject x beyond the viewport before an 8-bit x+width test can wrap.
evidence.quote: Clip against the 192-pixel original buffer before translating to the 256-pixel display. Reject x beyond the viewport before an 8-bit x+width test can wrap.
